Subject: Request: MAP & pilot — evaluation milestones and pricing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — FinTechX is excited about Redwood's latency profile for live financial chat. Procurement (copied Liza) asked that we put a short mutual action plan (MAP) together so stakeholders can track milestones and acceptance criteria during a 4–6 week PoC. A few asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood provide pilot/POC credits to cover evaluation usage? Our initial estimate is ~300k tokens across integration and load testing.
- Would you consider a one-week free trial extension if we need an extra week for integration hiccups?
- We need a clear conversion-to-paid price in the MAP so finance can pre-approve the budget (sensitivity around per-token pricing and any ramp discounts).
- Procurement will need a basic SOW and an idea of standard discounts for a 12-month committed contract if the PoC is successful.

Goal: sign MAP + SOW and kick off the week of Mar 9. Can you send a draft MAP with milestones (integration, performance test, evaluation sign-off) and commercial terms? Liza, I’ll need you to review procurement acceptance once we have pricing.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Turner
CTO, FinTechX

Hi Alex / Liza,

Great to hear — I pulled together a concise MAP and attached a draft SOW for review (FinTechX_MAP_v2.xlsx, FinTechX_PoC_SOW_v1.pdf). High level proposal below so we can align quickly: 

MAP (6-week target, flexible to 4):
- Week 0: Sign SOW & onboarding (assigned SE + infra prep)
- Week 1–2: Integration & feature validation (SDKs, auth, KV cache testing)
- Week 3–4: Load/perf tests (representative query mix, 95th p90 latency checks)
- Week 5: Business validation & demo to stakeholders (success criteria checklist)
- Week 6: Decision window (convert, extend, or wind down)

Commercials (PoC offer):
- Pilot credit: $5,000 in platform credits (applies to usage during PoC) covering ~250–300k tokens based on expected mix
- Trial extension: one-week free extension available if integration slips (notify by Week 3)
- Conversion pricing (if convert within 30 days of sign-off): list price $0.0025/token; for annual commitments we propose tiered discounts: 10% at $150k+ commitment, 20% at $300k+.
- Alternative: apply pilot credit as a one-time invoice credit toward month-1 if you sign a committed plan within 30 days.

Next steps: please review the attached MAP/SOW. If this looks directionally correct I’ll route to Rishi (AE) to finalize commercial concessions and Jordan (Legal) to quick-turn contract language.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- We will likely need that one-week extension — please confirm we can notify by end of Week 3 and it will be honored.

- Security: procurement will push a short vendor questionnaire; Liza will share. Please advise on typical turnaround for evidence (SOC2 attestation, data handling note).

Alex / team — quick commercial proposal to unblock procurement and preserve runway for conversion: 

1) Pilot credits: we can increase the pilot credit to $6,500 and/or accept a PO for 50% of the pilot (applies as a credit to first invoice). We prefer the blended approach: $6.5k credit + ability to apply up to $3.25k as PO if you want it as a firm buy-in.

2) Trial extension: confirmed — one-week free extension if notified by end of Week 3.

3) Conversion pricing guardrail: agree to a max of $0.0025/token for the first 6 months post-conversion if FinTechX signs a 12-month committed plan within 30 days after evaluation sign-off.

4) Commitment discounts (annual, by committed spend):
   - $150k+ : 10% off list
   - $300k+ : 20% off list
   - Accelerator: additional credit for early adoption (talk to AM for details)

5) Security docs: we can deliver SOC 2 Type II summary + data handling note within 3 business days; full artifact delivery typically takes longer but we can start gating for procurement review.

I attached an updated pricing table (pricing_table_q1_2026.csv) and a proposed clause to include in the SOW about credit application and trial extension. Jordan — can you confirm legal is OK with the PO-credit language and the 30-day conversion window?
